open.thesis: Team 13 roster Josh Allen and Lamar Jackson in a one-QB league and start Travis Kelce in their RB/WR/TE flex because no third receiver clears him. Golden fixes their flex; the quarterback they give up never plays.
open.falsifiedIf: They trade or drop one quarterback, acquire a third receiver, or Golden's price rises past what the flex gap is worth to them.
open.review: 14 Sep: harder than yesterday. Golden finished week 1 with 15.5, not the 1.5 the original card was written against, so they may now value him correctly. Also less urgent: Lawrence solves the quarterback problem for free.

open.thesis: Bowers had a meniscus trim and is out one to two weeks. Mayer is Las Vegas' TE1 and was extended three years. The IPADE flex takes a tight end, so a second startable TE has real value here.
open.falsifiedIf: Bowers returns and Mayer's route share drops back under about 50%.
open.review: 14 Sep: AT RISK, three weeks early. Schefter reports the Raiders believe Bowers misses only week 1 and returns at the Chargers. Mayer scored 9.2 and the role probably ends this week. He is the first drop candidate when something better appears — but not before Bowers actually plays.

open.thesis: Starts over Stafford from week 2. Ranked QB8 against Stafford's unranked, and Stafford is 38 coming off a career-high touchdown rate that will regress.
open.falsifiedIf: A quarterback trade lands, which makes Lawrence expendable, or Stafford strings together two clearly better weeks.
open.review: 14 Sep: CONFIRMED, emphatically. Lawrence scored 25.6 on the bench while Stafford started and scored 4.1. A 21.5-point swing in one week. Start Lawrence from week 2 without further argument, and note the quarterback trade is now a luxury rather than a need.

closed.summary: The kicker slot went Little -> Boswell on 8 Sep and Boswell -> Little on 10 Sep. The same slot reversed in two days for no stated reason. The clearest example of optimising noise on the record.
Allgeier added 8 Sep, dropped 10 Sep. Two days on the roster, no stated thesis either way.

The Tuten-for-Lamar proposal is withdrawn in favour of the Golden-for-Allen version. Its own card named the reason: Tuten is a 93.8% rostered Jacksonville starter and Lloyd is a committee back, so the single-week model that made the swap look free was pricing the wrong unit.
